Heroicons v2.2.0, 24px outline icons by Tailwind Labs.

The SVG files are unchanged copies of the official source:

- https://github.com/tailwindlabs/heroicons/tree/v2.2.0/optimized/24/outline
- https://github.com/tailwindlabs/heroicons/blob/v2.2.0/LICENSE

Used icons: `magnifying-glass`, `chevron-right`, `x-mark`.
Distributed under the included MIT license. Presentation size and color are applied in the consuming CSS.
